description: The current viberank leaderboard, ranked by API-equivalent cost. Each entry has rank, username, totalCost (USD), totalTokens, tools, verified, underReview and profileUrl. Pass tool to rank only the users of one tool; get_stats lists the tool slugs.

limit.description: How many top entries to return, 1 to 50.

tool.description: A tool slug such as "claude", "codex", "gemini", "opencode" or "copilot".
